title: Ennio
description: Giuseppe Tornatore pays tribute to Ennio Morricone in a documentary portrait of the prolific composer, exploring the breadth of the maestro's career across the hundreds of film scores he wrote.

title: A Fistful of Dollars
description: Wandering gunfighter Joe arrives in the Mexican village of San Miguel in the midst of a power struggle among sheriff John Baxter and the three Rojo brothers. He is hired by Esteban Rojo to join their gang, but he plays one side against the other.

title: The Great Silence
description: The mountains in winter provide the backdrop for this tale of a mute gunslinger who battles a band of bounty hunters.

title: The Mission
description: A Spanish slave trader (Robert De Niro) joins a Jesuit (Jeremy Irons) at a jungle mission in politically torn 1750 South America.

title: The Battle of Algiers
description: Between 1954 and '62, Algeria fights for independence from the French.

title: The Time Machine
description: H.G. Wells' time traveler journeys through time, experiencing several civilizations. Oscar-winning special effects.

title: Batman and Robin
description:
S01 E11 — Robin's Ruse
The duo plan to lure the Wizard from his secret lair.

title: Dr. Kildare's Crisis
description: Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) corrects Kildare's (Lew Ayres) diagnosis of nurse Lamont's brother's (Robert Young) head problem.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Odor of the Day
A dog finds shelter with a skunk during a snow storm.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Touche and Go
Pepé le Pew pursues a cat by the seaside, under the sea and on a desert island.

title: The Strip
description: A jazz drummer (Mickey Rooney) back from Korea meets a cigarette girl (Sally Forrest) and mobsters on Hollywood's Sunset Strip.

title: The Big Sleep
description: Raymond Chandler's private eye Philip Marlowe (Humphrey Bogart) follows two wealthy sisters (Lauren Bacall, Martha Vickers) through a maze of murders.

title: Action in the North Atlantic
description: The captain (Raymond Massey), mates (Humphrey Bogart, Alan Hale) and crew of a Liberty Ship dodge U-boats, dive bombers and foul weather to reach port.

title: The Americanization of Emily
description: A Navy officer (James Garner), ordered to document the first D-Day fatality, wines and dines a London widow (Julie Andrews).

title: Kanał
description: Polish partisans (Teresa Izewska, Tadeusz Janczar, Wisczyslaw Glinski) hide from the Nazis in the sewers of Warsaw.

title: Salvatore Giuliano
description: An outlaw goes to work for separatist politicians during the 1940s.

title: Jeopardy
description: A woman (Barbara Stanwyck) lures a fugitive (Ralph Meeker) to help her husband (Barry Sullivan), trapped under a piling at low tide.

title: Executive Action
description: Three powerful conspirators (Burt Lancaster, Robert Ryan, Will Geer) plot the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.

title: St. Ives
description: A dabbler-in-crime (John Houseman) and his assistant (Jacqueline Bisset) hire an ex-police reporter (Charles Bronson) to recover some stolen papers.

title: The Fastest Guitar Alive
description: A Rebel spy (Roy Orbison) with a shotgun guitar robs a mint with his partner (Sammy Jackson), then learns Lee has surrendered.

title: Spade Cooley: King of Western Swing
description: The rise in popularity of Cooley's blend of country and swing music.

title: Bob Wills and His Texas Playboys
description: A bridge between four classics of Bob Wills.

title: A Time to Sing
description: A Southerner (Hank Williams Jr.) turns country singer despite his guardian (Ed Begley) and falls for a tobacco farmer's daughter (Shelley Fabares).

title: Jeopardy
description: A woman (Barbara Stanwyck) lures a fugitive (Ralph Meeker) to help her husband (Barry Sullivan), trapped under a piling at low tide.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Canary Row
Sylvester spots Tweety inside the Broken Arms Hotel, but no cats are allowed in the lobby, so Sylvester has to think up other means of getting in.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Hare Trimmed
Granny gets into a love triangle, with Sam and Bugs both fighting for her hand in marriage; Sam wants Granny's money, and Bugs want to help Granny.

title: Father's Little Dividend
description: Father (Spencer Tracy) hears Daughter (Elizabeth Taylor) is pregnant in this sequel to Father of the Bride.

title: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
description: Two brothers, one an alcoholic (Paul Newman) who resents his devoted wife (Elizabeth Taylor), visit their dying millionaire father (Burl Ives) in the South.

title: Make Way for Tomorrow
description: An elderly couple (Victor Moore, Beulah Bondi) are at the mercy of their children, who consider them a burden.

title: Crossing Delancey
description: A Manhattan single (Amy Irving) meets a man (Peter Riegert) through her Jewish grandmother's (Reizl Bozyk) matchmaker.

title: Withnail and I
description: Two sloppy actors in 1969 London drive their beat-up Jaguar to a rough cottage owned by one's gay uncle.

title: The Women
description: Catty New York socialites gossip about a friend (Norma Shearer) and her husband's girlfriend (Joan Crawford).

title: So This Is Paris
description: A married doctor (Monte Blue) falls for a dancer (Lilyan Tashman), while his wife (Patsy Ruth Miller) develops an attraction to the latter's husband.

title: Through a Glass Darkly
description: Released from a mental institution, a woman (Harriet Andersson) spurns her husband (Max von Sydow) and seduces her teenage brother.

title: Hour of the Wolf
description: A Swedish painter (Max von Sydow) and his pregnant wife (Liv Ullmann) have symbolic visions on a secluded island.

title: MGM Parade
description:
S01 E11
Clip of Judy Garland and Gene Kelly in "For Me and My Gal"; host George Murphy.

title: So This Is College
description: An argument over a girl roommate distracts two Stanford football players (Elliott Nugent, Robert Armstrong) during a big game.

title: Gridiron Flash
description: A prison athlete (Eddie Quillan) gets a chance to play college football and date the coach's (Grant Mitchell) niece (Betty Furness).

title: Student Tour
description: A philosophy professor (Charles Butterworth) accompanies his school's rowing team on a worldwide tour.

title: Spring Madness
description: A student from a nearby women's college falls for a Harvard man set on a postgraduate two-year tour of Russia with his roommate.

title: She's Working Her Way Through College
description: A burlesque queen (Virginia Mayo) goes to college, charms a professor (Ronald Reagan) and livens up the class play.

title: Freshman Love
description: A crew coach (Frank McHugh) uses the college president's daughter (Patricia Ellis) to recruit top oarsmen.

title: Girl Crazy
description: A publisher's playboy son (Mickey Rooney) falls for the dean's granddaughter (Judy Garland) at an all-male mining school.

title: College Coach
description: A tough football coach (Pat O'Brien) takes his team and its singing star (Dick Powell) to the big game.

title: Too Many Girls
description: An heiress (Lucille Ball) attends a Southwest college with four football-star bodyguards hired by her father.

title: Latin Lovers
description: A rich girl (Lana Turner) follows her rich boyfriend (John Lund) to Brazil, where she flirts with a rich rancher (Ricardo Montalban).

title: Madame X
description: A young lawyer (Keir Dullea) defends an alcoholic woman (Lana Turner) accused of murder, unaware that she is his mother.

title: Sayonara
description: An American jet ace has a poignant affair with the star performer of a famed Japanese acting company.

title: The Reluctant Saint
description: An inept young priest-in-training is declared a saint when he begins floating about the monastery during prayer service.

title: Sombrero
description: Mexican love stories follow a dying man, a bullfighter's sister (Cyd Charisse) and lovers (Ricardo Montalban, Pier Angeli) from feuding villages.

title: Wyoming
description: An outlaw (Wallace Beery) leaves Missouri with his partner (Leo Carrillo) and reforms for children and a blacksmith (Marjorie Main).

title: Parachute Jumper
description: A Marine pilot (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.), his buddy and their girlfriend (Bette Davis) go to work for a gangster (Leo Carrillo).
